title: Beef Gyudon Bites with Thai Twist
description: A Japanese-inspired dish with a Thai twist, featuring crispy beef bites served with a rich and savory sauce.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
In a bowl, mix together beef, onion, garlic, fish sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar.
Using wet hands, shape the beef mixture into small balls, about 1-inch in diameter.
Dredge the beef balls in panko breadcrumbs, pressing gently to coat.
Fry the beef bites in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Drain the beef bites on paper towels.
In a small saucepan, combine sesame oil and 1 tablespoon of soy sauce.
Bring the sauce to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the fried beef bites to the saucepan and toss to coat.
Transfer the beef bites to a serving dish and garnish with green onions.
